description: A script for generating Zephyr device tree header files from devicetree source (.dts) files using edtlib, including functions for macro generation, dependency analysis, and handling devicetree properties.

classes.name: LogFormatter
classes.description: Custom logging formatter that outputs level name in lowercase for compatibility.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating argument parsing, edtlib setup, devicetree processing, and header file generation.

methods.name: setup_edtlib_logging
methods.description: Configures logging for edtlib module to output warnings and above to stderr with custom formatting.

methods.name: node_z_path_id
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier string for a devicetree node based on its path.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for input files, output files, and options.

methods.name: write_top_comment
methods.description: Writes a header comment with script info and devicetree dependency order.

methods.name: write_utils
methods.description: Outputs utility macro definitions.

methods.name: write_node_comment
methods.description: Outputs descriptive comments for a devicetree node.

methods.name: relativize
methods.description: Converts a path to a relative form if within ZEPHYR_BASE, with a prefix.

methods.name: write_idents_and_existence
methods.description: Generates macros for node aliases, labels, and existence flags.

methods.name: write_bus
methods.description: Creates macros related to a node's bus controller.

methods.name: write_special_props
methods.description: Outputs macros for special devicetree properties like regs, ranges, interrupts.

methods.name: write_ranges
methods.description: Generates macros for the ranges property of a node.

methods.name: write_regs
methods.description: Generates macros for the reg property of a node.

methods.name: write_interrupts
methods.description: Creates macros for the interrupts property, including IRQ mapping.

methods.name: write_compatibles
methods.description: Outputs macros for each compatible string of a node.

methods.name: write_children
methods.description: Creates macros for iterating over child nodes.

methods.name: write_status
methods.description: Defines macros for node status.

methods.name: write_pinctrls
methods.description: Outputs macros for pinctrl properties.

methods.name: write_fixed_partitions
methods.description: Creates macros for fixed-partitions nodes.

methods.name: write_gpio_hogs
methods.description: Generates macros for gpio-hog nodes.

methods.name: write_vanilla_props
methods.description: Creates macros for general properties of a node.

methods.name: write_dep_info
methods.description: Outputs dependency-related macros for a node.

methods.name: prop2value
methods.description: Converts a property to a C macro value if possible.

methods.name: prop_len
methods.description: Returns length macro size for a property if applicable.

methods.name: phandle_macros
methods.description: Generates macros for phandle properties.

methods.name: controller_and_data_macros
methods.description: Helper for phandle_macros, creates macros for ControllerAndData entries.

methods.name: write_chosen
methods.description: Outputs macros for devicetree 'chosen' nodes.

methods.name: write_global_macros
methods.description: Outputs macros for global/devicetree-wide info.

methods.name: str2ident
methods.description: Converts a string to a valid C identifier fragment.

methods.name: list2init
methods.description: Converts a list to a C array initializer string.

methods.name: out_dt_define
methods.description: Outputs a #define macro with optional width and deprecation warning.

methods.name: out_define
methods.description: Outputs a #define macro line with optional formatting and warning.

methods.name: out_comment
methods.description: Outputs a comment block or line to header file.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes backslashes and quotes in a string.

methods.name: quote_str
methods.description: Quotes and escapes a string for macro use.

methods.name: write_pickled_edt
methods.description: Serializes and writes the edtlib.EDT object to a file.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Raises an exception with a message.
